items.Name: Axe of the Minotaur Lord
items.Description: This fine weapon once belonged to the Minotaur Lord in the Luremaster's catacombs. The axe sports a double blade mounted on a solid oak shaft. It is finely balanced and may be used two handed with little difficulty. The axe is enchanted, giving the user a +4 to both hit and dama…

items.Description:
Boots of avoidance: 'Senses of the Cat'

The magic of these boots was specifically designed to detect incoming missiles and aid the wearer in avoiding them. They were originally commissioned by the instructor of an archery academy, who had tired of suffering "accidents" at the h…
PropertiesDecoded: Piercing AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +5

items.Name: Bracers of Icelandic Pearl
items.Description: It is said that these magnificent bracers were constructed in the Spine of the World Mountains, and not so long ago. On the coastline of the Sea of Moving Ice, there dwelled Prashnak, an abjurer -- and a stubborn one at that. Apparently Prashnak was having a great deal of diffic…

items.Name: Broken Armour
items.Description: This suit of armour, once a prized possession, is no longer fit for even a skeleton. It has been pierced in several places and crushed in others. The wearer could not have survived the blows that caused such damage.

items.Name: Broken Shield
items.Description: A mighty blow from some unknown weapon has shattered this shield into pieces.

items.Name: Bronze Key
items.Description: This key is made of bronze.

items.Name: Charged Battleaxe +2
items.Description: The battleaxe consists of a single blade atop a three- or four-foot shaft. It is a versatile weapon, and remains a useful tool when not in combat. It's obvious a lot of time and effort went into its creation and although not apparent at first a slight blue glow can been seen ema…

items.Name: Chautog's Thinker
items.Description:
This rare helm owes its creation to an orcish warrior mage.

Chautog's unusual story began when his village was destoyed in the crossfire from a battle between two rival wizard factions. One of the visitors, the enchanter Shandellon, felt a twinge of guilt when he surveyed the c…

items.Name: Cloak of Scintillating Colours
items.Description: The origins of this cloak have been lost in the mists of time. However, for some time it was in the possession of Drosus, a mage of no small power from Waterdeep. Drosus fell afoul of an unusually large group of winter wolves on a solo expedition into the Spine of the World moun…

items.Name: Copper Key
items.Description: This key appears to be forged from copper.

items.Name: Electrum Key
items.Description: This key seems to have been created from Electrum.

items.Name: Fire Flail +3
items.Description: Originally a farm implement for threshing grain, the light flail consists of a wooden shaft attached to a heavy or spiked head by a chain or hinge. The light flail is approximately two feet long. This flail has been magically enhanced. Runes can be seen glowing on every surface.

items.Name: Flawed Emerald
items.Description: An Emerald is a brilliant green beryl, cleaved along straight box like lines with rectangular cutiing in the finished gem. Emeralds are often connected with health, and so are used ornamentally for such a purpose.

items.Name: Flawed Moonbar Gem
items.Description: Moonbar is a pearly white, opaque gemstone, usually pale blue with green and gold mottling. Related in type to fire and black opals, but is only slightly more common.

items.Name: Flawed Pearl
items.Description: Pearls consist of types of layers of aragonite agonizingly formed around a bit of grit or other irritant inside oysters and other mollusks. The resulting pearl has a rich, deep luster. Most pearls in the realms are white, but there are rarer varieties, such as rainbow and black.

items.Name: Flawed Skydrop Gem
items.Description: Skydrop is the common name given to clear or lightly coloured tektite material; fragments of glass of celestial (meteoric) origin, found in the vast shifting sands of Anauroch and other deserts.

items.Name: Flawless Diamond
items.Description: This transparent crystal is the hardest substance found in nature. The most valued color is a clear bluish-white; most lesser stones are clear white or off-white, but other less valued color varieties are known, among them mauve, pink, peach, and chartreuse. Due to its hardness,…

items.Name: Flawed Fire Agate Gem
items.Description: Fire agate forms in thin brown layers that refract the incoming light, giving the gem its "fire." The refraction often forms patterns reminiscent of a dragon's scales, which makes it prized by sorcerers who claim to trace their lineage back to dragonkin. A well-cut stone has its…

items.Name: Flawless Moonstone Gem
items.Description: Moonstone is an opaque, white feldspar gem polished to a bluish sheen. Old legends say that the sight of a moonstone would cause a lycanthrope to revert to his animal form. Whether or not this is true is unknown as anyone close enough to find out apparently hasn't lived to tell …

items.Name: Flawless Star Sapphire
items.Description: Star Sapphire is a precious variation of the sapphire, however is more translucent, with a white star highlighted in its center. A star sapphire has been known to ornament devices which protect against magic.

items.Name: Flawless Sunstone Gem
items.Description: Sunstone is a feldspar gem, closely realted to moonstone, and mroe proerly known as oligocalse. Sunstones can be colourless or faintly greenish and of facet grade, but most common by far is its softer (cabochon) variety. This yields gemstones that have bright red or orange spang…

items.Name: Flawless Waterstar Gem
items.Description: Waterstar is also called achroite or colourless tourmaline and is rare in the Realms.

items.Name: Gold Key
items.Description: This key appears to be crafted from gold.

items.Name: History of Nether Scrolls
items.Description: The writing in this text is completely indecipherable and resists any such attempts at comprehension through normal magic or any other means.

items.Name: Holy Symbol of Helm
items.Description: This finely crafted holy symbol is sacred to the god Helm. The symbol depicts an upright war gauntlet with a staring eye on the front. The gauntlet itself is crafted from the finest platinum, the white of the eye is carved from mother of pearl, and a blue sapphire has been used …

items.Name: Bastard Sword +3: Incinerator
items.Description: Besides its superb craftsmanship, tiny runes can be seen etched all along the surface. It's obvious a lot of time and effort went into its creation and although not apparent at first, a slight blue glow can be seen emanating from the runes.

items.Name: Two-Handed Axe +2: Life Giver
items.Description: A favorite of barbarians, the greataxe is the largest of the weapons derived from the basic woodcutter's axe. The double-edged head is far more suited to cleaving opponents than trees. Dwarven runes have been etched into the giant blade to further enhance the axe.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Light Wounds (2) Cast Spell 5 Uses/Day

items.Name: Dead God's Dreaming
items.Description: The story of the ascension of Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul, the gods of strife, murder, and death, is well known among learned men across the face of Faerun. Despite this, most theologions know very little about what happened to the unfortunate dying god whom the malefic trio consume…

items.Name: Maluradek's Journal
items.Description: This red-stained journal looks to have once been professionally bound, but the texture of its sodden pages suggest it was recently dropped in wine or blood and has yet to dry. items.Name: Great Shield +3
items.Description: The tower shield is a veritable wall of protection, though it can be quite cumbersome to carry on an adventure. This one is so large that it impairs the wielders attack.

items.Name: Cloak of Non-Detection
items.Description:
Cloak of non-detection: 'Whispers of Silence'

Reportedly created for a linage of the greatest burglars ever to walk the night, this cloak was apparently a success. No record exists of previous owners.

items.Name: Studded Leather +2: Missile Attractor
items.Description: While improving the protection against all melee weapons, this armour actually becomes a target for missile weapons, and hence so does its wearer. The choice is simple, deadly arrows or deadly swords.

Slashing AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +2

items.Name: Spear +4, Backbiter
items.Description: This cursed spear will appear as a magical spear, however when a combat situation arises, the wielder will attack an enemy and backbiter will attack the wielder. For every attack made, backbiter will attack the foe and also the wielder. This is a powerful spear, but on must ask …

items.Name: Scimitar +3, Frostbrand
items.Description: The scimitar shares some similarities with the longsword and other slashing blades, but the severity and thickness of its curve clearly sets it apart. The origins of the scimitar are largely unknown, however they have been very popular in the southern region of the Forgotten Rea…

items.Name: Hell's Bane
items.Description: This fine broad sword is of unusual construction. The blade is crafted from an unknown dull black metal, but the edge appears to be of the finest silver. Fiery, red runes have been etched the entire length of the blade. When examined closely, the runes writhe with a life of thei…

items.Name: Long Bow of Marksmanship
items.Description: Long bow of marksmanship: This bow is enchanted to enhance its damage and boosts the users aim.

items.Name: Long Sword of Action +4
items.Description: The longsword is the weapon most commonly associated with knights and their ilk. There are many variations in the blade, but all are approximately 35 to 47 inches in length. The blade of this sword is covered with all sorts of arcane symbols.

items.Name: Manuscript of the High Watcher
items.Description: While the front and back of this heavy-bound book are tarnished bronze, its spine is nothing more than rotting cords of hemp strung through the covers and thick pages within. Despite the tarnished surface and drapery of cobwebs covering this manuscript, the writing within appear…

items.Name: Morning Star of Lesser Phasing
items.Description: The morningstar is a derivative of the mace that includes a chain tether - similar to the flail - to add velocity when swinging its compact striking surface. Morningstars commonly have at least one formidable spike as an added feature of the head. This example has a few runes on…

items.Description: A large shield is effective protection for the adventurer who can afford the added weight and encumbrance. This one seems to glow with a eerie blue light.

items.Description: This ring was given to the reef scavenger and hunter known as Edventar, by a group of aquatic elves long his friends. His help in routing the "Pirate Queen" of Dambrath was instrumental in their survival, though Yenandra continues to be feared anywhere water meets land.

items.Name: Ring of greater resistance
items.Description: Rings are commonly worn on the fingers as ornamentation, but some are potent magic items. This one appears warm to the touch.

items.Name: Tarnished Ring
items.Description: This ring is identical to the one Hobart wore upon his finger when you met in Lonelywood. A series of indecipherable runes are etched upon the dull face of the copper band. The inner surface of the beand bears the simple inscription: "Truth is Eternal".
